jobs.prompt: Edit the attached isolated male eye pair (the sole EDIT TARGET). Keep adult masculine proportions, the same grey-brown iris DIAMETER and dark pupil size as this reference, and the same pupil-centre positions and spacing. REDUCE THE OVERALL EYE OPENING rather than enlarging the iris: each almond opening about 10% narrower horizontally and 18% less tall, by softly drawing its corners closer to the iris and relaxing the upper lid slightly lower and the lower lid slightly higher. This must visibly reduce the white corners and the white crescent below the iris. The actual eyes must be smaller than the reference, never expanded horizontally or vertically, and irises must NOT become large doll/anime circles. Pupil centres and gaze stay exactly level, frontal and calm. The exposed iris remains natural and is partially covered by the upper lid. Preserve soft rounded corners and complete natural short upper lashes plus sparse lower lashes. Preserve this painting's warm grey-brown, charcoal ink, matte Chinese ink and light watercolour brush texture. Reduce sclera to small gently shaded ivory corners, no broad bright white band, no heavy eyeliner, no detached eyelid highlights. Only eyes, eyelid ink and lashes on a real transparent canvas. NO eyebrows, skin plate, surrounding face, scalp hair, labels or diffuse brown glow. Same canvas aspect ratio, eye pair in one row. The key change is smaller natural eye openings with LESS sclera while retaining moderate original iris size; do not make the whole pair or the irises larger. Retain the calm long almond curves.
